hotels.title: Stylish Manly Beachside Retreat with Prime Manly Beach Location & Ocean Views
hotels.description: Contemporary coastal-chic accommodation meets an incredible location at this beachside haven, superbly positioned just steps from one of Australia’s most iconic stretches of coastline. Appreciate the stunning azure waters from your private balcony with a morning brew in hand before heading down to dive into the waters of Manly Beach. Outside the hotel, foodies will be thrilled with the endless options nearby - share plates at Little Pearl Bar & Dining, classic Cantonese at Queen Chow Manly and fresh seafood at The Herring Room.

hotels.title: Manly Harbour National Park Retreat on Secluded Beachfront with Four Restaurants & Bars
hotels.description: Nestled within the historic grounds of Sydney's former Quarantine Station at North Head, this extraordinary hideaway pays homage to the city's rich history. Embark on a thought-evoking tour, delving into the historic tales brimming within the station's corridors, then discover a tranquil stretch of secluded beachfront, offering breathtaking views of Sydney Harbour National Park. With an array of delectable dining options across four venues, indulge in delicious cuisine. This meticulously maintained historical lodging is conveniently situated just a 30-minute ferry journey from Sydney's CBD, or a five-minute drive from the bustling heart of Manly. This prime location allows you to easily delve into Sydney's renowned attractions and dining offerings, all while relishing a tranquil escape from the urban hustle.
